title: Offline multi-horizon forecasting of public-mempool workload (Flashbots Mempool Dumpster)
status_note: Extends the frozen P2 benchmark (experiments/results/flashbots_horizon_benchmark_v2) with more horizons, a gas target, a learned linear baseline and more metrics. 2026-10-12 was already opened once by P2 at H = 10 s and 60 s; FB-FC-v1 results on that day are therefore a second look, not an untouched test.
target_definition: y(t) = mean of the 1-s series over [t, t+H); forecast issued at origin t from series[0:t] only (lead 0).

D.use: fit: EWMA alpha, ridge coefficients and lambda, regime cut-offs

F.use: scored once after the selection is frozen

models.persistence_interval: naive / persistence: mean of the last H seconds (= last value at H = 1 s). REFERENCE for skill.
models.seasonal_naive_12: mean of [t-12, t-12+H): same phase one Ethereum slot (12 s) earlier; only when H < 12
models.seasonal_naive_60: mean of [t-60, t-60+H); only when H < 60
models.seasonal_naive_300: mean of [t-300, t-300+H); only when H < 300
models.rolling_mean_60: mean of the last 60 s; omitted when 60 = H (identical to persistence)
models.rolling_mean_300: mean of the last 300 s; omitted when 300 = H
models.expanding_mean: mean of everything since 00:00 UTC of the same day
models.ewma: exponentially weighted mean of the 1-s series, alpha tuned on D
models.ridge_ar: ridge regression on trailing means over 1, 5, 10, 30, 60, 300, 900 s (+ seasonal_naive_12 when H < 12), standardised; fit on D, lambda by 5-fold expanding time-series CV inside D
models.tod_profile_0921: EXPLORATORY, F only: the 2026-09-21 value of the target at the same UTC time of day. Not selectable (it cannot be scored on V without reading V's future).

selection_rule: lowest V MAE; models within 1% of the best are tied and the earliest in simplicity_order wins
regimes: terciles of the trailing 300-s mean arrival rate at the origin, cut-offs fitted on D origins (H = 60 s grid), applied to every pool and both targets
significance: Diebold-Mariano (absolute-error loss, Bartlett HAC, HLN correction) selected vs persistence_interval per target x horizon; Holm across the 8 comparisons
random_seed_note: No stochastic step: every model is deterministic. The seed is recorded only for the EDA subsampling convention.
